verdict.rationale: Crossmint offers testnet wallet flows (e.g., the stablecoin wallet quickstart transacts on 'Base Sepolia') letting devs test wallet/payment logic without mainnet funds, but the docs explicitly state for Agent Checkouts that 'there is no staging environment for it' meaning testing is production-only for that flow. This is an internal inconsistency across the product's own components rather than a single unified sandbox story. missing for 10: a documented sandbox/staging environment covering agent cards and agent checkouts (not just wallets), explicit guidance on isolating test vs production data across all agent products, and independent confirmation of sandbox behavior.
